body:
## Summary

The **full preset exists and is largely declarative-correct** (`Schema::full()` wires 23 nodes + 10 marks), but the audit found **one hard schema gap (media `mime`/`size_bytes`), one missing feature (§2.5 migration/envelope v2), a public-API violation (`Schema::basic`/`SchemaBuilder` are still public), an a11y projection divergence (`ordered_list.ordered` can never be set; `hard_break` is silently dropped), and a metadata-limits gap (no entry cap)**. Test coverage is presence-only in the key places, so all of these pass CI today.

Tests were **not executed** (no shell/exec tool available in this environment); every finding below is static, from source.

---

## Matrix A — Nodes & a11y role (plan 11 §2.1)

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `paragraph` (+`align`) | Present | `schema/full/nodes.rs:20-27` (align `:25`), role Paragraph |
| `heading` + `level:1..6` | Present | `nodes.rs:29-45` (level `:33-38`, align `:39`, `with_level(AttrId(1))` `:42`) |
| `bullet_list` `tight`,`checked?` | Present | `nodes.rs:47-54` (attrs `:51-52`) |
| `ordered_list` `start`,`reversed`,`tight`,`type` | Present | `nodes.rs:56-65` (attrs `:60-63`) |
| `list_item` | Present | `nodes.rs:67-72`; role ListItem; `checked` `:70` |
| `blockquote` | Present | `nodes.rs:74-79`, role Quote |
| `code_block` `language`,`meta`,`line_numbers` | Present | `nodes.rs:81-89` (attrs `:85-87`), role CodeBlock |
| `raw_code` `language`,`format`,`filename`,`meta`,`line_numbers`; payload text, no HTML | Present | `nodes.rs:91-101`; `format` enum `:96`; content `text*` `:94`; no `.marks_all()` ⇒ MarkMode::None |
| `table` `summary`,`col_widths` | Present | `nodes.rs:103-116` (`:107-115`) |
| `table_caption` | Present | `nodes.rs:118-123` |
| `table_row` | Present | `nodes.rs:125-129` |
| `table_header`/`table_cell` `colspan,rowspan,scope,align,abbr,headers` | Present | `nodes.rs:131-150` (attrs `:135-140`) |
| `figure` | Present | `nodes.rs:152-157`; content `image_block caption?` |
| `caption` | Present | `nodes.rs:159-164` |
| `separator` | Present | `nodes.rs:166-171`, role Separator |
| `image` **inline atom** | Present | `nodes.rs:173-191` spec, `:193-195` `.group("inline").inline()` |
| `video`/`audio`/`attachment` atoms | Present | `nodes.rs:201-214`, `216-228`, `230-242` |
| `hard_break` **inline atom** | Present node / **missing a11y role** | node `nodes.rs:244-246`; no `.a11y(...)` ⇒ dropped from tree (`a11y/build.rs:170-171`), and `A11yRole` has no line-break variant (`a11y/role.rs:13-58`) |
| `text` | Present | `nodes.rs:13-18`, role Text |
| Document root role | Present | `schema/spec.rs:221-228` (`A11yRole::Document`) |
| **Extra** node not in §2.1 | Divergent (extra) | `image_block` `nodes.rs:197-199`; registered `full/mod.rs:45` — broadens the contract beyond the enumerated schema |

**a11y role divergence — lists:** both list nodes project `A11yRole::List`, but the projection reads a non-existent `"ordered"` attribute: `a11y/build.rs:63` (`attr_bool(...,"ordered")`) vs. schema attrs `start/reversed/tight/type` (`nodes.rs:60-63`). Therefore `A11yNode.ordered` (plan 10 §3; `a11y/tree.rs:60-61`) is **always `None`** for `ordered_list`. No test catches it.

---

## Matrix B — Marks

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `strong`,`em`,`code` | Present | `schema/full/marks.rs:10-18`; `code` has role Code `:17` |
| `underline`,`strike`,`highlight`,`sup`,`sub` | Present | `marks.rs:20-38` (no a11y spec — matches plan, marks have none required) |
| `link` `href,title,rel,target` | Present | `marks.rs:40-47`; `href` required `:41`; role Link + TextContent `:46` |
| `ref` `target: RefTarget` | Present | `marks.rs:50-55`; `AttrType::Ref` required `:52` |

---

## Matrix C — Media attributes (plan 11 §2.2 + plan 12 §5)

| Attr | image | image_block | video | audio | attachment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` (required) | ✓ `:176` | ✓ (shared) | ✓ `:206` | ✓ `:221` | ✓ `:235` |
| `src` | ✓ `:177` | ✓ | ✓ `:207` | ✓ `:222` | ✓ `:236` |
| `asset_id` | ✓ `:189` | ✓ | ✓ `:212` | ✓ `:226` | ✓ `:240` |
| `width`,`height` | ✓ `:179-180` | ✓ | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** |
| `intrinsic_width`,`intrinsic_height` | ✓ `:181-182` | ✓ | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** |
| **`mime`** (plan 12 §5) | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** (`media_type` instead, `:238`) |
| **`size_bytes`** (plan 12 §5) | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** | **✗** | ✓ `:239` |
| `title` | ✓ `:178` | ✓ | ✓ `:209` | ✓ `:223` | — |
| `srcset`,`sizes`,`caption`,`credit`,`loading`,`decoding` | ✓ `:183-188` | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `poster`,`transcript`,`controls`,`filename` | — | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ `:237` |

- **Plan 11 §2.2 image list is complete** (src, alt, title, width, height, intrinsic_*, srcset, sizes, caption, credit, loading, decoding) — `nodes.rs:176-188`.
- **Plan 12 §5 additions are incomplete**: `mime` absent everywhere; `size_bytes` only on `attachment`; dimensions/intrinsic missing on `video`/`attachment`. `attachment.media_type` is a naming divergence from the specified `mime`.
- **`data:` rejection (plan 12 §5: "nunca aceita `data:`") is not implemented**: zero occurrences of `data:`/`javascript:`/`scheme` in `crates/rich-editor-auy/src` or the WASM crate; `src` is a plain `Str` (`nodes.rs:177`).

---

## Matrix D — Attribute system & metadata (plan 11 §2.3)

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `AttrType::{Str,Int{min,max},Bool,Ref,Enum,List,Map,Any}` | Present | `schema/spec.rs:9-28` |
| `AttrValue::{Null,Bool,Int,Str,Array,Map,Ref}` | Present | `model/attrs.rs:12-28` |
| `Map` ordered by key, no HashMap | Present | `model/attrs.rs:37-49` (`AttrValue::map` sorts + dedups); decode `wire/attrs.rs:129-137`; validation `schema/mod.rs:213-221` |
| `metadata` as canonical object | Present | `full/attrs.rs:19` `Map(Str)`; doc attrs `:12-19` |
| Depth limit for attr values | Present (global) | `model/limits.rs:76-82` → `limits.max_depth` (`lib.rs:50,68`) |
| **Entries-per-map / metadata entry cap** | **Missing** | `Limits` has no map-entry field (`lib.rs:44-61`); `check_value_limits` counts bytes/keys only (`model/limits.rs:83-101`) |
| Envelope keeps publication `doc_id` **and version** | Partial | `Envelope { doc, doc_id }` only — `wire/envelope.rs:19-24`; no publication version field |
| Reserved stable `id` on nodes | Present | `schema/spec.rs:132-137` (reserved `AttrId::NODE_ID`); doc attrs intentionally start at 0 (`spec.rs:248-255`) |

---

## Matrix E — Construction visibility (plan 11 §2.5, §2 line 21)

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `Schema::full()` exists | Present | `schema/full/mod.rs:22-59` |
| `Schema::basic()` not public | **Divergent** | `schema/preset.rs:18` `pub fn basic` |
| `SchemaBuilder` `pub(crate)`/testkit only | **Divergent** | `schema/mod.rs:16` `pub use builder::SchemaBuilder;`; `schema/builder.rs:20`; `Schema::builder()` public `schema/mod.rs:46` |
| `basic` only as private migration fixture | **Divergent** | used by ≥14 test files (`tests/a11y.rs:8`, `tests/editing.rs:12`, `tests/common/mod.rs:14`, …) and `bench/benches/hot_path.rs:28,42,63,78,89` |
| Bench `all_types` uses `Schema::full()` | **Divergent** | still builds `rich_schema()` — `bench/examples/all_types.rs:31`, used at `:290` |
| TS `basicSchema`/`documentSchema` removed | Present | only `fullSchema` in `packages/ts/packages/schema/mod.ts:14` |
| TS exposes `SCHEMA_FINGERPRINT` + types | Partial/divergent | only function `fingerprint()` `packages/ts/packages/core/mod.ts:600-602`; no `SCHEMA_FINGERPRINT` constant |
| Docs/CHANGELOG reflect removal | **False claim** | `CHANGELOG.md:64-65` says one public preset; `plan/09_frontend-e-referencias.md:84,87` still shows `basicSchema` |

Note: `Schema::basic` is not a v1 twin of `full` — `paragraph` is `"text*"` and `dir`/`lang` are `Str` (`preset.rs:33-42`, `preset.rs:25-27`) vs `inline*` / `dir: Enum` (`nodes.rs:23-24`, `full/attrs.rs:13`), so the missing migration function would also need a content/attr remap.

---

## Matrix F — Envelope & migration (plan 11 §2.5)

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `Envelope` gains `schema_version = 2` | **Missing** | no such field: `wire/envelope.rs:19-24`; writer emits `"version":1` `:46` |
| Fingerprint in envelope | Present | `:46-47` (write), `:83-91` (verify) |
| Reader accepts v1 / rejects unknown | Divergent | only `version == 1` accepted: `:76-81`; no v2 path |
| `migrate_v1_to_full` adds defaults, re-emits envelope | **Missing** | no `migrate*` symbol anywhere in `crates/*/src` or tests (grep) |
| Unknown types during migration fail with `UnsupportedNode` | **Missing** | no variant in `SchemaError` (`error/schema.rs:8-38`) |
| Envelope honors `ParseOptions.limits` | Divergent | `from_json` hardcodes `crate::Limits::default().max_depth` (`envelope.rs:68`) |
| Envelope has any test | **Missing** | no test file references `Envelope`/`version` (tests list; grep) |

---

## Matrix G — §2.6 token policy & `raw_code` semantics

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Unknown node/mark/attr rejected, not stored/`Any` | Present | `wire/parser.rs:140-149,258-261`; `wire/attrs.rs:62-67`; unknown mark `:238-240`; required attr `:88-93` |
| No `embed` escape hatch | Present | no `embed`/`Any` attr declared in `full/*` |
| Atomic failure | Present (decode returns `Err` before `Doc` build) | `wire/parser.rs:26-29` |
| Failure type is `ProblemDetails` (RFC 9457) | Partial/divergent in core | core returns `ParseError` (`error/wire.rs:8-32`); `ProblemDetails` exists (`error/problem.rs:13-171`) but is only constructed/mapped at the WASM boundary (`rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/problem_map.rs:40-75`, `problem.rs:12-169`) |
| `ProblemDetails` min fields type/title/status/detail/instance/code/suggestion | Present in struct | `error/problem.rs:14-29`; JSON serialization only in WASM `problem_map.rs:192-228` |
| All listed codes exist (`unknown_token`,`unknown_mark`,`unknown_attr`,`invalid_attr`,`unrepresentable_feature`,`missing_asset`,`duplicate_id`,`stale_batch`,`limit_exceeded`) | Partial | only `unknown_token`, `unknown_attr`, `unknown_mark`, `unrepresentable_feature` constructors in `error/problem.rs`; others only as WASM-local builders (`rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/problem.rs:53-169`) |
| `raw_code` block `text*` without marks, role code, `code_language` in `A11yNode` | Present | `nodes.rs:91-101`; role `a11y/build.rs:62`; test `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:11-36` |

---

## Failing-test-quality audit (missing / falsely passing)

**Falsely passing / presence-only**

1. `tests/schema_full.rs:125-170` `full_schema_covers_blocks_marks_and_attrs` — the name claims attrs but the body only does `schema.node_kind(name).is_some()` (`:154`) and `mark_id(name).is_some()` (`:168`). Zero attribute assertions; would pass with `image` lacking every attr.
2. `tests/schema_full.rs:10-39` `assert_image_attrs` — presence-only list `:15-30` that **omits `mime`/`size_bytes`**, so plan 12 §5 gaps are invisible. Also ignores types/ranges (an `Int` attr could be declared `Str` and pass).
3. `tests/schema_full.rs:172-202` `full_schema_declares_list_and_table_attrs` — checks only `ordered_list` names, `table.col_widths` type and `table_cell` names. Never checks `code_block`, `paragraph/heading.align`, `table.summary`, `table_header`, `bullet_list.tight/checked`.
4. `tests/schema_full_attrs.rs:60-96` round-trip includes `<hard_break/>` (`:66`) but never asserts the a11y tree, so the dropped `hard_break` passes.
5. `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:71-115` asserts cell roles/names only; never asserts `scope`/`colspan`/`rowspan` projection (plan 10 §golden requires them).
6. `tests/schema_full_problems.rs:5-33` only unit-tests `ProblemDetails` constructors — never asserts an ingestion path returns a problem for a real unknown token/attr/mark, nor the full 7-field JSON.
7. `tests/schema_full.rs:252-…` fingerprint test only asserts self-consistency + attr sensitivity; **no golden constant**, so the full-schema fingerprint can change silently.

**Missing tests**

8. No test for `Envelope` at all: version field, `schema_version=2`, fingerprint mismatch, round-trip.
9. No migration test (and no function to test) — §2.5 unimplemented.
10. No test that `Schema::basic`/`SchemaBuilder` are not part of the public API (no trybuild/compile-fail test).
11. No negative tests against `full`: image/video/audio/attachment without `alt`; unknown node/attr/mark; `data:` src.
12. No test that `raw_code` rejects marks (MarkMode::None) — only checks `content == "text*"` (`schema_full.rs:57-59`).
13. No a11y-role coverage test across all declared nodes (no assertions for `separator`, `video`, `audio`, `attachment`, lists, `blockquote`, `code_block`, `image` inline atom).
14. No test for `metadata` entry/depth limits (entry limit doesn't exist).
15. No test for `ordered_list.ordered` projection — the bug in Matrix A would be caught by one.

---

## Exact gaps (ordered by impact)

1. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/full/nodes.rs:173-242` — `mime` declared nowhere; `size_bytes` missing on `image`/`image_block`/`video`/`audio`; `width`/`height`/`intrinsic_*` missing on `video` and `attachment`; `attachment.media_type` (:238) is not the specified `mime`.
2. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/preset.rs:18` + `schema/mod.rs:16,46` + `builder.rs:20` — `Schema::basic` and `SchemaBuilder`/`Schema::builder` are public; plan 11 line 21 and §2.5 require full-only.
3. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/wire/envelope.rs:19-24,46,76-81` — no `schema_version=2`; envelope has no publication `version`; no v1→full migration; `from_json` ignores `ParseOptions.limits` (:68).
4. No `migrate_v1_to_full`; no `UnsupportedNode` variant (`error/schema.rs:8-38`).
5. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/build.rs:63` — reads `"ordered"`, never declared by `ordered_list` (`nodes.rs:60-63`); `A11yNode.ordered` always `None`.
6. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/build.rs:170-171` + `nodes.rs:244-246` — `hard_break` has no `A11ySpec` and is silently omitted from `A11yTree`; `A11yRole` has no line-break role (`role.rs:13-58`).
7. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/lib.rs:44-61` / `model/limits.rs:76-101` — no map-entry cap for `metadata` (plan 11 §2.3 requires entry limits); only global depth + per-string bytes.
8. No `data:`/scheme rejection for media `src` anywhere in core or WASM (plan 12 §5).
9. `bench/examples/all_types.rs:31,290` — still builds `rich_schema()` instead of `Schema::full()` (§2.5); `bench/benches/hot_path.rs:28…` uses `Schema::basic`.
10. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/full/nodes.rs:197-199` + `full/mod.rs:45` — extra `image_block` node, not in plan 11 §2.1's canonical type list.
11. `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/full/attrs.rs:12` vs `model/validate.rs:54-59` — doc `lang` is optional, so `A007` ("lang ausente quando o schema exige") is dead code under the full schema.
12. `CHANGELOG.md:64-65` and `plan/09_frontend-e-referencias.md:84,87` assert single-public-preset/`basicSchema` removal that contradicts the code (Matrix E).
